newsitem.title: TAIWAN: China Steel T$1.5/share dividend granted.
newsitem.headline: China Steel T$1.5/share dividend granted.

text.p: Taiwan's China Steel Corp said on Thursday its shareholders' meeting had approved a dividend of T$1.50 per share for 1995/96 (July/June) for its common and preferred shares.
"Our shareholders' meeting just approved the T$1.50 dividend per share proposed by our board meeting in early September," a company spokesman told Reuters.
The dividends include T$1.25 in cash, and T$0.25 in stock dividend, or bonus issue, paying 25 shares free for every 1,000 shares held, he said.
China Steel, Taiwan's largest steel maker, was privatised in April 1995.
